message.content: 《里斯本条约》（正式名称为“关于欧洲联盟（欧盟）条约”）于 **2007 年 12 月 13 日** 在葡萄牙首都里斯本签订。该条约随后在 2009 年 12 月 1 日生效，取代了原有的《马斯特里赫特条约》与《阿姆斯特丹修正案》。
message.reasoning:
The user asks "里斯本條約是在什麼時候簽署的?" which translates from Chinese as "When was the Lisbon Treaty signed?"

We need to answer with the date when the Lisbon Treaty (Treaty on European Union) was signed.

I know it was signed on December 13, 2007. It entered into force on December 1, 2009. So we should provide the signing date and maybe mention entry into force.

But the instruction says: If you don't have enough info or uncertain, ask clarifying question. But I do know this fact. We can just give the answer.

Thus respond:

"Lisbon Treaty was signed on December 13, 2007."

Optionally add context: Signed at the Portuguese capital Lisbon; came into effect Dec 1, 2009.

No tool needed.
